copy.tagline: 集成 WhatsApp Cloud API 到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在开发需要 WhatsApp 消息功能的应用
copy.tagline_en: Integrate WhatsApp Cloud API into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building an app that needs WhatsApp messaging

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 WhatsApp Business Cloud API 与用户进行一对一聊天。它能够接收和发送 WhatsApp 消息，并支持多用户会话。
howto.when: 当用户完成安装和配置，并通过 /manage-channels 将 WhatsApp 通道绑定到代理组后，Claude 即可处理来自 WhatsApp 的消息。

say.text: 帮我设置 WhatsApp 通道，连接我的 Meta 应用。
检查 WhatsApp 通道是否已正确配置。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can chat one-on-one with users via the WhatsApp Business Cloud API. It can receive and send WhatsApp messages and supports multiple user conversations.
howto.when_en: After completing installation and configuration, and binding the WhatsApp channel to an agent group via /manage-channels, Claude can handle messages from WhatsApp.

say_en.text: Help me set up the WhatsApp channel and connect my Meta app.
Check if the WhatsApp channel is configured correctly.
